balls.text: Terrific over from Bhuvneshwar. Fuller and outside off, swings his bat at it and misses, takes a run.
Five wickets for Bhuvi! How good was that?  Pace off this time, short of full length pitched wide of off, Shami throws his bat at it but can't clear Jansen at long-on
Bangs in short and wide of off, Shanaka cut away to point for one

Gets a wicket but it's a run-out!</b? Fuller and wide of off, a swing and a miss from Noor. He looks to get a quick run but Klaasen throws the ball quickly to Bhuvneshwar who then effects a direct run out at the non-striker's end
Out for duck! Full length outside off, pace off, Rashid swings his bat hard at it with no timing, gets a thick outside edge as Klaasen collects the ball calmly to give Bhuvneshwar his fourth wicket
In the air and taken! Fuller wide of off, tries to go over covers where Samad bends forward and takes a good low catch to dismiss the centurion
Full toss around off, flicked away toward offside for one
Length ball around off, lofts it toward long-off
In the gap! Full toss on middle, muscled away between long-on and deep midwicket for four
Bouncer on off, tries to upper-cut and misses
Maiden IPL 100 for Gill! Full length on middle and off, pushes to long-off for one. A 56-ball hundred for GT opener and he acknowledges the crowd after reaching the three-digit mark
Full length on middle and off, pulled away to deep midwicket
Yorker on off, digs it out to offside for one
Short ball and pace off, wide of off,pulled away to deep midwicket for one. 111kmph
Yorker around off, hit along the ground to long-off to get off the mark. Welcome to IPL
Excellent catch by Jansen! Slow ball, a length ball outside off, Jansen runs back a few yards from mid-on and takes the catch. Make it four wickets in four overs
Full toss on middle, comes down and chips it in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket. Samad puts in a  dive and keeps it to two
Short ball wide of off, called wide. Tewati charges down and then leaves it
Yorker on offstump, digs it out to covers for one
Full length on fifth stump, cut away to covers to keep the strike
Full length outside off, hit towards backward point
Taken! Full length around off, heaves it towards long-off, doesn't get the elevation as Markram completes an easy catch to remove his country-mate
Fuller on middle stump, picks it up nicely to hit to wide of square leg for one bounce four
Short and wide, pulled down towards deep midwicket for a single
Short of full length around off, pushed to wide of mid-on for one
Full length on middle, taps it towards long-on for one
Full length outside off, moves away a bit, and cut away to deep cover for one. Moves to 95*
In the gap! Full length outside off, and slices it between backward point and short third for four
Knuckle ball. Full around middle and off, pushed towards mid-off to get off the mark
Straight to backward point! Full around off, Hardik tries to slice it in the gap for four but is caught by Tripathi
Fuller on fifth stump, cut away to deep cover for two runs
Full around off, punched to deep cover for one
Bangs in a bouncer now, pulls this away to deep square where the ball falls just short of the fielder and runs to the rope as he dives
Fuller on middle and leg, pushed to deep square leg for a single
Length ball on off, cut away to deep cover for one
Full length around offstump, defended back to bowler
Taken! Fuller wide of off, he swings his bat at it and Natarajan goes back a few yards from backward point to complete the catch. Sai gone for 47!
Full outside leg, goes back and pulls this away to deep midwicket
Slow and very full outside off stump, pushed towards wide of covers for four
Fuller and wide of off, waits for it to push it toward cover
Full outside off stump, cut away to deep cover for one
Fuller on fifth stump, legbreak, cut away to deep extra cover
Fuller on middle stump, whips it away to deep midwicket for one
Short of a length ball on off, pulled away to wide of short fine leg for four
Length ball on off, punches down to mid-off for a risky run again. A mix-up with the bowler at non-striker's end
Fuller around off, drills it to long-on for one
Short and wide of off, pulled toward wide of deep midwicket for two
Dropped! Length ball outside off, just lofts it over Natarajan's head who got his left hand on it but can't hold on to the ball
Fuller around off, driven straight to mid-off
Played it very late to cut a ball pitched outside off and full, to beat the point for our
Driven straight to mid-off
Too straight now. Full and on legstump, pulled over deep midwicket for a six. There it is, Gill's first six today
Slides it down legstump, wide
Fuller outside off, pushed towards long-on for one
Fuller around off, slower in the air, pushed to deep extra cover
Yorker on middle, digs it out. 141kmph. 15 runs from the over, uff
Fuller outside off from around the wicket, cut away to deep extra cover
Short of a full length outside off, directs it to third man for one
Mistimes a pull towards deep midwicket where the fielder fumbles a catch and the ball runs towards the rope. Oops, four runs!
Goes for a wideeee yorker but called wide
There it is, the first six of the innings! Fuller on middle, Sai moves across and scoops it over fine leg for a six.
Fuller on legstump, Gill moves across and hits it towards mid-off for one
Full length around off, cut away to point
Touch and go for backward point. Fuller outside off, Sai lofts it over the offside fielder for four
Full length on leg, pushed to short fine leg for one
Down the leg, swept away to fine leg
Fuller outside off, punched towards covers where Markram makes an excellent dive to stop the ball
Fuller on middle again, pushed to midwicket for a single
Fuller on middle, flicked away to backward square leg for one
Full length outside off, inside-edges to square leg for one
Short ball outside off, pulled down towards deep midwicket
Length ball around off, flicked toward vacant midwicket for two
Full length around off, pushes to deep point for one
Full length around off, punches on the back foot to deep cover
Starts with a bouncer, Gill leaves it
Hit along the ground to wide of long-on for one
Fuller on middle stump, defended to extra cover
Full on middle, goes back and flicks it toward deep midwicket for one
Fuller outside off, sliced it toward deep cover for one
This time pulled away toward square leg for four
Fifty for Gill! Length ball on off, cut away  towards backward point
Fuller and flatter on middle and leg, pushed to square leg for one
Short of a length ball outside off, pulled away again, this time in front of square
SHort on middle and leg, pulled away towards backward square leg for four
Full length outside off, pushed to vacant square leg where Markram runs in and keeps it to two
Fuller outside off, cut away to deep point for one
Fuller and flatter around off, pushed to deep midwicket for one
Length ball outside off, cut away to third man to keep the strike
Shot! Full length outside off, comes down the track to hit it straight for four
Full length around off, defended to covers
Length ball outside off, flicked towards deep midwicket for one
Short ball outside offstump, goes back and punches it to wide of mid-on. Excellent
Full length around off, flicked to mid-on
Full length on legstump, taps it to wide of short fine leg and collects two runs
Full length outside off, drills it straight to backward point
Full length on middle and leg, pushed to midwicket
Short of full length outside off, goes for swipe and gets hits on the thigh
Length ball on middle and leg, tries to go offside, outside edges to backward point
Full length outside offstump, hit towards covers
What an over for GT! Looked like a slow ball, short on legstump, just directs it to deep fine leg
Full length outside off, punched down the ground towards point where Samad fails to collect the ball
Back to back fours! Length ball on middle and leg stump, goes back and flicks it in front of square leg for four
In the gap! Length ball around off, brings out his short arm jab to place the ball wide of mid-on for four
Misfield at covers. Full length outside off, drills it toward offside and takes two
Length ball on middle and off, punched towards point
Full length around off, hit along the ground towards long-on for four. 15 runs from the over
Short ball on middle, pulls away to midwicket, falls just short of the fielder again
Full length around off, just taps it to legside
Another good shot! Full length outside off, angling away, Sai punches it towards cover for four
Full length on middle, flicks towards the vacant midwicket region for three
Shot! Full length delivery on middle, it swings a little bit, opens the full face of the bat for a straight drive towards long-off
Full length outside off, punched down to covers
Full length and outside legstump, Klaasen jumps to his left but can't stop the ball
This time wide has been signalled. Another bouncer outside off, goes for the same shot
Short ball outside off, goes for a pull and misses. Looks at the umpire for a wide
Full length around off, knocked to covers
Good stop by Markande. Length ball around off, punches on backfoot to covers where the fielder makes an excellent dive and throws at striker's end
Full length ball on middle, drills to square leg
Full length ball outside off, gets forward and lofts it over covers for a clean four
Bangs in a short ball outside legstump, wide
Full length on middle, pushes towards legside, falls just short of midwicket
Full length on the middle stump, flicked to deep fine leg for one. Just five runs from the over
Shot! And well fielded by Tripathi. Full length around off, pushes towards covers and Tripathi puts in a dive to save the boundary
Full length ball around off, defended to mid-off and takes a risky quick single. A direct throw would have seen him run out
Edged and taken! This is exactly what Bhuvneshwar wanted. Length ball outside offstump, an outswinger, Saha nicks it and Abhishek at second slip completes the catch
Full length outside offstump again, moves away a bit and Saha leaves this alone
Movement up front. Full length outside off, Saha lets it go

Swings and misses, Titans move to 18 points and ensure a place in the top-2. Fireworks go off in the background. It was a fullish legbreak that landed around off and spun big to beat the attempted heave over midwicket
Makes room and drives the full ball to long-on

Rashid reaches the ball at deep square leg, there's a fielder coming in from the other side - Mavi running in from the right, and Rashid overruns it and the ball bursts out of his hands and goes to the boundary
Leading edge off the back-foot flick takes the length ball to short third
Looped up at 83kph, Farooqi's eyes lit up, he wound up and swiped to go over midwicket. Missed it by quite a distance
Dances down and gets to the pitch, driven down to long-on
Length ouside off, blocked to cover point
Bouncer at 132kph delivered with another grunt, which has been a constant feature in Mohit's bowling. Farooqi flicked his head towards the off side in reflex

Rashid runs in from deep point and takes the catch, Mohit has four. It was a wobbling length ball on fourth stump, Bhuvi made room and tried to flay it over cover. It may have been a bit too short for the shot. It went off the flashing outside edge, Rashid covered quite a few metres, decelerated close to the finish and took it comfortably.
Yorker on middle and off at 141kph, Markande was standing just outside leg and whipped it along the ground to long-on
Slapped down the ground again. This was a slower back-of-hand ball that was short and curving away. Not far from the off-side tramline and that allowed Markande to swat it
Heaved away over long-on. It was a 135kph skiddy back-of-length ball just outside off, Markande pulled it 76 metres far
Top edge off the pull with limited power lands safely at square leg as no one was in the circle. Ball was just outside off and hit from around chest-height
Back-of-length ball pitches around off and angles away at 132kph, beats the attempted punch to cover off the back foot
Back of length around off, guided to deep third
Pitched up with a bit off room offered. Bhuvi's able to slap it over cover off the front foot
Bouncer is too high but Bhuvi tries to upper cut it in the last second but it goes over fourth stump to the keeper
Full and slow on fourth stump, Bhuvi makes some room and tries to lash it over cover. Gets it just over the infield after half-timing it
Swings and misses. Tried to go over mid-off there
No, full on off, Markande's behind it and blocks it towards cover.

Miller doesn't spot it right away but is able to take the catch over his right shoulder while bending his knees. It was an overpitched ball that Klaasen tried to thump over long-off again but found the fielder. Shami has a four-for. Miller turned and shook his head after taking the catch, Mohit, coming in to high-five had an end-to-end smile
Full and wide, outside edge off the cover drive goes to deep third

Klaasen tries to pull the 140kph back-of-length ball but doesn't have enough room given he was trying to back away. The ball didn't go at full speed but was quick enough as it went to Shami's right for him to not reach after it
Not far from a yorker but Bhuvi is able to clip the ball off the outer-half of the bat to the left of Shami
Length on off, stays leg side and tries to mow it with a horizontal bat. Doesn't generate great power, ball rolls to long-on
Length on off, worked back to the bowler

Belted down the ground and it whacks Noor on the ankle in follow-through. He falls on his back and will get medical attention. It was a shortish slow ball outside off and Klaasen middled it. It was going low and Noor was about to jump in reflex. It bounced off the boot towards long-off. He went right down and that's it for Noor today. He hobbles off with arms around shoulders of a couple of people.
Thumps an overpitched ball downtown. It was at the stumps, Klaasen backed away and hit it over the straight mid-off area
Short ball outside off is cut to deep point
Tossed up invitingly on a length, kept wide too. Bhuvi isn't tempted, lets it go
Noor misses his line, goes down leg. Bhuvi tries to sweep the full, slow ball and misses, it deflects fine off the pad
Overpitched at the stumps, stays leg side and drills a drive into the pitch. Bowler half-stops it before chasing and cutting it off within the ring
Back of length just outside off, blocked off the back foot to point
Low full toss on leg is flicked to deep midwicket
Slower one into the pitch is belted past the bowler. It was a back-of-hand slower one on a back of length, Klaasen freed his arms and got it to the left of the bowler and then speed along the ground
Mohit bowls the full ball on fourth stump and grunts, Bhuvi stays leg side and whips it into the pitch. Ball rolls to long-on
Length on fourth stump, punched to cover
Back of length just outside off, punched to long-on
Klaasen gets to a fifty with a cut to deep point, gives a thumbs up. It was slow legbreak on a length that spun away. Rashid does finish wicketless.
Length ball is flat on middle, blocked back to the bowler
Works the length ball while hopping and gets it to wide long-on
Full ball is worked back to the bowler
Opens the face to the length ball curving away to off stump, steers it in the gap to the right of slip for a four.
Length ball is flicked to long-on
Overpitched on off, driven to long-off
Length on off, flicked to deep mdwicket
Low full toss on off stump at 91kph, pushed to the bowler's left
Outside edge off the cut goes fast and wide of slip, short third chases in vain. It was a length ball outside off and Bhuvi slashed at it hard
Shortish ball on fifth stump, pulled to long-on
Noor tosses it up and Klaasen accepts the invite with a slog sweep over midwicket. It was full around off and heaved away for a 76-metre six. Hardik is not pleased
Flat batted from just outside off, didn't look to have had enough room but managed to land the ball around mid-on and take it to the deep
Length outside off, slapped into the pitch a in the square. Goes to point on the bounce
Full around eighth stump, reaches out and drives into the pitch. Ball goes to cover
Slightly fuller but a replay of the last ball apart from that
Back-of-length ball at 135kph drifts down leg, beaten on the flick
Length outside off, defended off the back foot to cover
Slot Full on middle and off, opens the face and pushes it to away to deep point
Length outside off, tries to drive it off the back foot on the up. Beaten
Tossed up wide at 88kph, Bhuvi reaches out and carves it in the air. Wide to the right of point for a single
Shortish ball rips back in and gets good bounce to beat Bhuvi's cut
Outside edge off the cover drive takes the full ball angling away past slip off the outside edge
Slaps the length ball outside off to long-off
Clubs it straight again. No chance for long-off

Miller palms it over the boundary at long-off. Noor should have had a first-ball wicket, tossed it up on middle. Klaasen made space and pumped it to Miller's right, who tried to take it to his right on the move but ended up popping it over
Googly at 88kph spins in towards off, cut to deep point
Googly on middle, flicked with the spin to deep square leg
Flicks the length ball to deep-backward square
Rashid slows it down. Klaasen goes back to the 88kph length ball down leg and flicks it from well down leg to wide long-on
Full ball on off, Bhuvi opens the face of the angled bat to guide it towards point
Length-ball legbreak spins away to off stump, cut to long-off

Launched but it's too high, Hardik settles underneath at mid-off and takes it. It was a length ball on middle, Jansen was standing just outside leg as he tried to drive it through the line, he finished with the bat way high but got it off the bottom. No big celebrations, GT know they have this game and a playoff spot almost in the bag
Length in the channel, punched to cover
Length outside off, cut to deep cover
Length outside off, slapped away. Rashid runs to the right from deep point, tumbles over and closes the wrist a bit too early. It pops up but stays nearby and won't cost him extra runs
Length ball jags in towards top of off, jammed on the last second to mid-off
Shortish ball just outside off, slapped away to the right of deep point, who runs a few metres and keeps it to two. Pace: 131kph
Goes back and flicks the length ball behind square
Overpitched on off, drives it in the slightly uppishly but there's no one at mid-on. Stopped in the deep
Steps down and stabilises as he knocks the length ball with a fully closed bat face, back to the bowler
Length ball lands around off and spins away, cut to deep point
Length on middle, backs away as he chops the 95kph ball to backward point
Flicks the full ball on off to long-on
Punches the length ball to cover
Length outsie off, cut to deep point

Picks the slower one and whacks it straight to Mavi at midwicket. Mohit joins his hands and looks at the heavens in celebration. Titans' playoff spot seems all but sealed. Samad was waiting on the back foot, having charged last ball. Mohit did indeed go short and Samad tried to muscle it with all his might and lost his shape. It went flat to the fielder
Down the track, slapped on the move. Rashid races to the right from deep point but has no chance. Samad charged early and the ball landed right on a length but he got it on a fuller and creamed it.
Flicks the length ball to midwicket

Top edge off the cut is taken by Sai Sudharsan at deep third and SRH are five down. Mid-off was left open and Sanvir tried to go over the infield. Mohit went into the pitch and despite the batter backing away, he wasn't able to manufacture enough room to slap it away. Deep third ran to the right and took it
Full on fifth stump, worked to long-on
Pulls the shortish ball from fourth stump to long-on
Lays into an inside-out drive over extra. Hit with the spin and with a full extension on the arms. The ball was full, pitched around off and turned away
Makes ample room and gets followed by a flat, length ball at 90kph. Whips it away through midwicket, stopped in the deep
Full on the stumps, defends back to the bowler
Length just outside, Klaasen backs away and tries to drive it off the back-foot through cover. Misses
Pulled away over wide mid-on. Sanvir was waiting for the hard-length ball on the back foot, flat-batted it with a bit of a flourish and it sailed over the first few rows
Length ball just down leg, Sanvir swipes across and misses the horizontal-bat flick. Ball goes off the bat towards point
Length on fourth stump, punches it off the back foot to the left of cover
Length outside off, cover driven off the back foot straight to the fielder on the off side

Outside edge hovers in the air and Shanaka takes it at forward point. It was a 145kph length ball around off, Markram tried to close the face and clip the ball through mid-on. Shanaka took an easy catch and Titans' celebrations continue
Charges and is beaten by the length ball angling in. Markram tried to whip it away on the move and was cut in half
Length on middle, stays leg side again and tries to drive it on the rise. Gets a bit big on him, outside edge takes it to deep third
Off drive on the up, crunched it and no one moved. It was full on middle and off, Markram stayed leg side and hit through the line
Flicks the 132kph length ball from middle and leg. Mid-on runs back in the chase, stopped in the outfield
Length ball just down leg beats the flick, goes off the thigh pad to the leg side
Length outside off, guided to deep third
Length outside off, punched through cover. Stands still and gets it in the gap, Miller dives to the left but can't get to it
Length outside off, defended off the back foot to cover point. Misfield on the dive has another fielder chase and Titans concede an overthrow
Punched away, Shanaka runs from cover point pulls it in and the back-up fielder throws it back. It was on a length and Markram middled it, got it along the ground
Shortish ball outside off is defended to the off side
Length outside off, guided to deep third
Length ball in the channel, Klaasen tried to play the line with a straight bat and missed it

And Tewatia at wide slip gets catching practice. Tripathi was backing away as the length ball seamed away, he tried to caress it off the horizontal bat while on the back foot. He tried to open the face last second and got it off the sticker, Tewatia took a good catch over his shoulder.
Jags back in, Markram jabs at the shortish ball, gets it to point
Punched past cover, mid-off runs to the left and stops it with a tumble. Fullish ball on fourth, Tripathi took a small stride and allowed the ball to come towards the bat and played it gently

Outside edge off the flashing cover drive and taken by Saha. It was a length ball that pitched around fourth stump and seamed away big time. Sharma went through with the waft and got it off the toe of the bat. Saha takes a dolly, Dayal runs and leaps to punch the air in celebration
Length just outside off, moves away again. Patted off the back foot to point
Wide down leg, beats the flick and Saha has to go quickly to his right to stop it
Back of length outside off, beaten on the cut
Creamed off the back foot through cover point. Outswinger on a length, driven with the movement. Went along the ground. Thirty four off Dayal's last seven balls, says Raghav, our scorer
Slight back of length on off at 132kph, blocked to cover

Top edge off the pull is in the air... Rashid runs across from deep third and takes it. Rashid trodded a few steps to his diagonal left, waited a second and took it around waist height. It was a back-of-length ball that Anmol tried to swipe across to go through square leg
Shortish ball outside off, cut in the gap behind point
Hard-length ball beats the flick and goes off the thigh pad towards cover

Edged and Tewatia drops it at first slip! Pitched up just on off, straightened a bit and found Anmol's outside edge. Tewatia leapt to his right and tried to take it with both hands but it burst away and went to deep third
Length on leg, flicked to midwicket
